comment: sha256 of every SKILL.md this project has shipped, line endings normalized to LF. A file matching one of these is an old packaged copy that `skill install --update` may replace; anything else is treated as the owner's edit. Append the hash of the new SKILL.md here whenever you change it (a test enforces this).
